directive: Named all Titan combat kits, weapons, gear, and abilities around each faction source-culture mythology while preserving leveling hooks and counterplay.

difficultyModel.campaignNormal: Enemies stay mostly fixed by mission so leveling feels meaningful; later missions introduce denial and elite mechanics earlier than before.
difficultyModel.eliteRemix: Elite variants add +12% hp, +10% damage, one extra mechanic layer, and smarter objective/resource targeting.
difficultyModel.endgame: Dynamic scaling capped at effective player level +8; boss difficulty comes from phases, adds, counters, and arena rules.

upgradeRisks: Empowered Techniques cannot chain every round
gearRules.sourceCultureRule: All relic weapons, armor bodies, and resonance cores must express the Realm as the older source behind Earth mythology; no generic implements, realmplate, or charge-core naming.
